question: Can the additional recorded joint-load residuals reject I60 false overrides while preserving useful contact corrections?
scope: Offline single-factor acceptance-veto experiment. Freeze I60 candidates, geometry, score weights, raw rankings and accepted proposals. No point cap, force fitting, temporal smoothing, velocity-zero enforcement, native observer/controller change or default promotion.
historical_conditions: I58 native B, Gazebo/DART Mars figure-eight,44s,yaw45deg,shaft-1/+0.3/+0.9rad,caps1.5/.6/.6Nm/.3/.3m/s,8801states each
inference_inputs: I60 stored observer-derived normal hint and frozen selected candidate IDs
native estimated family loads and point
candidate_reconstruction: Reconstruct only frozen I60 selected IDs using unchanged normal seeds/band/rim projection. Proposed F winner and F best valid candidate inside native family may be exported; native-family comparator is diagnostic only. Never relabel the native equivalent point onto an invalid patch.
prediction: For world force F at candidate point p on body b, raw generalized load is Jp(q,p,b).T F. Rotate its free-base angular rows3:6 with current fork rotation to compare with stored gamma whose first6 are world-frame; joint rows6:9 remain scalar generalized torques.
frame_and_clock: Stored observer force/moment were rotated with interval-midpoint attitude before filtering; current candidate uses current geometry. Observer is filtered preceding5ms, truth is last completed1ms. Validate frame transforms and retain this timing/model qualification, without fitting a delay.

primary_veto.tolerance: Each joint uses0.03Nm+0.10*R*norm(observed_force). All3 absolute residuals must be <=that value.
primary_veto.invalid_rule: Nonfinite/missing state, candidate, residual or scale vetoes the proposal and returns native fallback; no new point or new family is selected.
primary_veto.decision: Absolute componentwise gate only. No native-relative gate or new soft-score term.
primary_veto.interpretation: Fixed engineering tolerance, not a calibrated probability or measured noise covariance. A failing single-resultant model does not prove the candidate is physically wrong.

information_qualification: First3 predicted force rows reproduce F by construction; base moment repeats lever/wrench consistency; shaft row largely projects net moment. Additional routing information is mainly two shell-joint rows. Torque-null/pole configurations and multicontact can remain ambiguous.

policies.N: Native family from dominant positive unique exact_estimated_support_loads_N and native exact_estimated_contact_point_m.
policies.A: I60 accepted F proposal family AND point when accepted, otherwise N. Accepted SAME-family point changes are included. This accepted/fallback hybrid, not all raw F rankings, is the primary I60 comparator.
policies.C: Use exactly the A proposal family AND point only when I60 accepted AND the extra3 load gate passes; otherwise N. No geometry interpolation, new weight or different candidate search.

feature_sealing: Compute all three cases' predicted loads, residuals, load-pass flags and N/A/C outputs, bind source/input hashes and seal them before opening any truth fields. Prior I60 truth-derived targets/masks must never be loaded into inference.

evaluation.window_convention: Half-open[start,end); all8801rows extracted but unheldterminal44s excluded from interval metrics.
evaluation.eligibility: Reuse I60 dominant-support eligibility/ties/clock exactly; >=90%onefamily is not strictsinglephysicalcontact. No-candidate/native-unknown retained as errors.
evaluation.stable_subset: Same I60 eligible family unchanged throughout +/-10ms, evaluator only.
evaluation.harmful_override: Native N is correct on eligible state, but policy A or C is wrong. Count on ALL primary eligible states, not retained-only subsets.
evaluation.useful_correction: Native N is wrong, but A proposal is correct. Retention requires C remains correct on those same states.
evaluation.point_targets: Logged truth_equivalent_point_m primary; dominant-family means and radial-R proxies descriptive. Use same finite native/A/C/target rows for all paired statistics. Missing coverage is explicit.
point_subsets: one resolved>0.05N contact, not necessarily one physical point
evaluation.no_abstain_all_win: Report useful retention, proposal/veto/override coverage, errors and point distances on fixed full denominators; returning N everywhere fails benefit/retention gates.

oracle_geometry_diagnostic.timing: Only after all truth-blind feature/policy outputs are sealed.
oracle_geometry_diagnostic.point: Logged dominant-family truth_patch_points_m at current saved pose, raw and finite; do not project toR or require it lies on a material band.
oracle_geometry_diagnostic.force: Same OBSERVED total force as inference, not a true-force substitute.
oracle_geometry_diagnostic.computation: Export truth-blind per-family joint affine load maps from current q and observedF. Evaluator inserts the raw logged point into Jlinear(centre).T F + Jangular(centre).T cross(point-centre,F).
oracle_geometry_diagnostic.denominator: All primary stable dominant-support eligible states per phase; invalid/missing oracle points/maps count as failed compatibility, with explicit coverage.
oracle_geometry_diagnostic.gate: At least90% pass the same extra3 tolerance per phase.
oracle_geometry_diagnostic.qualification: Oracle-GEOMETRY compatibility of a single total-resultant-force approximation with a filtered residual; not independent9-row force ground truth or noise calibration. Weaker/additional contacts, friction distribution and clock effects remain.

gates.empty_denominator: Unscorable gate is not a pass.
gates.interpretation: All fixed offline gates required to recommend any later controlled integration; no threshold selection or score tuning after outcomes. Primary performance and model-validity gates reported separately as well as combined.

fixed_adverse_events: Retain all I60 prespecified event times and all three I60 worst-point times (-1:35.205,+.3:38.380,+.9:17.765s), reporting candidate/native/oracle residuals and veto decisions with missing cases explicit.
required_controls: source and input hashes before arithmetic
no truth/terrain/reference reads in feature stage
all three feature seals before truth evaluation
carrier contact zero external shell-joint loads
valid candidate separated from arbitrary virtual oracle point
matched-mask N/A/C metrics and abstain-all failure
physics_scope: No new physical simulation in the offline experiment. A controlled handoff pair is considered only if all offline gates pass and a separate source-bound adapter/physical protocol is ready; no broad trajectory rerun or default adoption follows automatically.
